coverage.employer: California university slice — scope and stopping point
coverage.note: Broad surname-first pass over UC campuses, many CSU campuses and major private universities, all fields. Queries covered Nguyen, Tran, Le, Pham, Bui, Huynh and selected rarer surnames; directory leads were checked against current roster and already-proposed.txt. Ten new candidates verified; stopped after broad institutional coverage and diminishing returns. This is not an exhaustive census of every campus or surname. Coverage entries below distinguish retrieved pages from discovery-only leads. No Issues/PRs, roster mutations, ID assignments, portrait-file downloads or test-generated timestamp changes were made.

Biology, computer science, electrical engineering, accounting, history, nursing, ethnic studies and academic leadership leads screened. Hao Nguyen is new; Sy Bang Tran is already vp-2636. Nursing Michelle Dang left unproposed for missing affirmative Vietnamese signal, leadership Michael Nguyen for missing underlying current appointment. Historical booklet's Bang Tran doctorate conflicts with live profile; not copied.

Medicine, tobacco/substance-use research, infectious disease, immunology and broader surname searches. Nhung Nguyen and David Nguyen are new.
